title: ID0417607-DC/Si-D/PL-[ Y2/S3 300000004049 ] error while restarting the charger
description:
Reported issue:  The charging message was sent after stoptransaction. After restarting the charger during the session. This took place during intergration testing. This is a critical error and a failure to comply with OCPP rules. We did not pass ingegration with the head MSP in Poland. Please act quickly and escalate the ticket to L3. I am attaching a pictures of logs.
Solution:  N/A
yyyy-mm-dd:  2025-07-04

additional_info.subject: Analysis
additional_info.body:
There are 2 tests customer performed, one with soft reset and other with hard reset.
During charging with soft reset, charger is sending status Unavailable and in session_stop unexpected as False.
During charging with hard reset, charger is sending status Charging and in session_stop, unexpected as True.
As per the Soft and Hard reset description, this behavior is correct, but still need to confirm with experts.
